## Validation and handoff

The strategy retrieved all **10 of 10** records in the development set (100% relative recall against that set). These records were used during development; there were no user-supplied seeds or held-out validation set, so recall on unseen records was not estimated.

The optional psychology/theory block was left out after testing: it would reduce the count by 61.2%, while losing five known relevant records; two of 30 records in its loss sample were relevant. The final count exceeds the standard 10,000-record screening budget, an open workload risk. The count is from current PubMed with the requested entry-date bound, not a reconstruction of PubMed as it stood on that date.

This is a draft and needs **PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use**. The internal critic was automated and does not replace that review.
